name: Adafruit ESP32-C6 Feather (4 MB flash)
description: Wi-Fi 6, BLE 5 and 802.15.4 (Thread/Zigbee/Matter) ESP32-C6 Feather with 4 MB flash, USB-C, LiPo charger with fuel gauge, STEMMA QT and a low-quiescent LDO for deep sleep.
notes: USB Serial/JTAG only (no USB OTG): CircuitPython cannot present a USB drive, use Wi-Fi/BLE/web workflow.
IO6 and IO5 are wired to both A2/A3 and the D6/D5 header positions, so 19 unique GPIO sit on 21 header pins.
Secondary low-quiescent LDO gives about 17 uA deep-sleep from LiPo.
Frequently out of stock at Adafruit.
